name: Winchendon, MA
nextStep: Download the wiring application and email it to the Building Department at afronte@winchendon-ma.gov.
payments: The town offers online payment. Confirm the amount and payment timing for your application.
inspectionNotes: Call 978-297-3537 ext. 247 to arrange a wiring inspection.

name: Athol, MA
nextStep: Download the wiring application and confirm where to submit the signed form and how to pay.
payments: Confirm payment method with the town.
inspectionNotes: Use Athol’s separate inspection instructions for electrical scheduling.

name: Orange, MA
nextStep: Apply through MGO Connect. Select the Building Department and choose the applicable wiring permit.
payments: Pay online, by check, or by money order. No cash. Paper wiring applications carry a $25 processing fee.

name: Gardner, MA
nextStep: Apply and track the electrical permit in Viewpoint Cloud. Complete the city’s Good Standing Certification as part of the application.
payments: Online card payment is available. The city also lists check payment at the City Hall Annex.

name: Troy, NH
nextStep: Call the Selectmen’s Office or email the Building Inspector to confirm the process for standalone wiring.
inspectionNotes: Town Hall coordinates appointments with its contracted inspector. The new-construction process includes a rough electrical inspection.

name: Keene, NH
nextStep: Start in the city’s online permit and inspection portal. Building Safety lists electrical among its permit types.

name: Fitzwilliam, NH
nextStep: Download the electrical application and ask the Building Department whether it accepts the signed form and payment remotely.

name: Winchester, NH
nextStep: Call the Building Inspector to confirm how to submit the separate electrical trade permit.
inspectionNotes: Published office hours are Monday and Thursday, 7 a.m.–5 p.m. Weekday inspections are by appointment.

name: Hinsdale, NH
nextStep: Download the electrical application and call before driving to Town Hall. Ask about sending a signed PDF and paying remotely.
inspectionNotes: Published Code Enforcement office hours are Monday–Thursday, 7:30 a.m.–noon.

name: Swanzey, NH
nextStep: Email Code Enforcement to ask which application and submission route apply to standalone electrical work.
inspectionNotes: The building permit checklist includes rough electrical inspection. It does not establish the standalone wiring filing route.

name: Rindge, NH
nextStep: Download the electrical form. Call or email Building before visiting to confirm remote submission and payment.
